<fidel-reading-guide>

Reading guide. Outlines the paragraph you are in, can dim the rest, and moves block by block with Next line and Previous line.

Who it helps:ማንን ይረዳል፦ Low-vision learners at 200 to 400 % zoom, and learners with dyslexia or attention difficulties.

Live exampleየቀጥታ ምሳሌ

This example is live: try it with the keyboard, a mouse or touch, and a screen reader.ይህ ምሳሌ ቀጥታ ነው፦ በኪቦርድ፣ በማውዝ ወይም በንክኪ፣ እና በስክሪን አንባቢ ይሞክሩት።

A web page is a text file that a browser turns into what you see. The text is written in HTML.

HTML uses tags, such as a heading tag and a paragraph tag, to say what each part of the page is.

ድረ-ገጽ አሳሹ ወደሚያዩት ገጽ የሚቀይረው የጽሑፍ ፋይል ነው።

Code to copyየሚቀዳ ኮድ

<fidel-reading-guide target="#lesson-text"></fidel-reading-guide>
<div id="lesson-text">…</div>

Source: player/src/components/d/reading-guide.js

Attributesመለያዎች (attributes)

Attributes of <fidel-reading-guide>
AttributeValuesDefaultMeaning
targetCSS selectornoneThe text to guide through.
ui-langen, amthe page's lang, else enLanguage of the component's own buttons and messages.

Eventsክስተቶች (events)

None.

Keyboard and screen readerኪቦርድ እና ስክሪን አንባቢ

  • "Reading guide" turns it on and off. "Next line" and "Previous line" buttons move block by block and scroll it to the middle of the screen.
  • It follows the pointer, the text cursor and keyboard focus. Overlays only: it never changes your text or takes clicks.

Languagesቋንቋዎች

Its own buttons and messages are in English or Amharic. Set ui-lang="am" on the tag (or on a parent); without it, the page's lang is used, else English.

Accessibility and WCAGተደራሽነት እና WCAG

  • 1.4.1 Use of Color: A thick outline, not colour alone; dimmed text stays above 4.5:1.
  • 2.1.1 Keyboard: Next and Previous line buttons for keyboard and switch users.

The full WCAG 2.2 AA conformance report
